wp: WP2 single-factor designs: prediction screen, then paired causal check
base: R3_T = LawFit(law=two, sigma_s=0.10, transient_ref=restart, steps=True, steps_mode=gap_endpoint, beta_mode=one); REF = 0.75 R3_T + 0.25 V2

designs_main.B0: switch rows (day-resolution, D0.3) -> kind switch, T = mean(last row of earlier segment, first row of later segment), throughput 0; true_ck unchanged
designs_main.S: B0 + calendar clock tau_cal = sum days * aT(37.3 on time) * k_SOC(SOC)^2 / kappa; k_SOC = WP1 TUM table; kappa = time-weighted mean of k_SOC^2 over visible observed rows; SOC rules: observed = F2 series, switch = SOC at last row of earlier segment, true_ck = first half entry SOC then half 0 %, seg_gap/extrapolated = mean over last visible 45 C segment (k_SOC^2 averaged, not SOC)
designs_main.C: calendar clock Ea on time = 2 x 20.592 = 41.184 kJ/mol; break-in and cycle clocks 37.3 on time; priors unrefit
designs_main.O1: R3_T at tau_b in 134.48 x 2^{-2,-1,0,1} d = {33.6, 67.2, 134.5, 269.0}; per-case weights proportional to exp(logZ), logZ = -0.5 |r|^2 - 0.5 log det(J'J) at the MAP (prior rows included, numerical J over free parameters); exposed-tau_b
designs_main.O2: B0 + overhang state replacing break-in: dX/dt = (xe - X)/tau_oh(T), xe = (SOC - 0.30)/(SOC_op - 0.30), X(CK0) = 0; tau_oh = t_full/3, t_full = 100 d exp(64.5 kJ/mol / R (1/T - 1/323.15 K)); SOC_op = time-weighted mean SOC of visible observed rows; logA_oh ~ N(ln(0.062 (SOC_op - 0.30) 102), ln 2); calendar sqrt(tau_cal) and cycle terms unchanged; SOC rules as S
designs_main.D: cycle term and its prior row removed

C: Ea_time 74.6 (Yagci read as on k; exposed-CK2)
O2: tau_oh from the three-point fitted Arrhenius line

deviations_registered_here.D1.4: S weights time by k_SOC^2 (virtual-time consistency, same as the Ea doubling in C); the prompt's linear form is a sensitivity
deviations_registered_here.D2.1: the tau_b grid is 134.48 x 2^k so that its 134-d member equals R3_T exactly (prompt: 33.5/67/134/268)
deviations_registered_here.D2.2: O1 Laplace weights are computed per (case, step variant); eps does not enter the fit

cases: causal = PG1, PG2 (k 4-7), PC5, PC10, CS, CSE (k 3-7) = 28 cases; real k 1-7; delta 0.4 main variant a4s 2 for the screen

step1_screen.stat: dSOH = SOH(X) - SOH(R3_T); S_causal = 90th percentile |dSOH| over causal cases; S_real = max over real k
step1_screen.inert: skip step 2; D inert -> accepted as non-inferior by definition
step1_screen.no_proxies: the screen script never loads H.QFC, proxy or err (assert + grep in REPORT)

step2_paired.q_i: |err_X_ens| - |err_REF| per causal case, X_ens = 0.75 X + 0.25 V2
step2_paired.report: mean, share < 0, per-k block means, LOKO means, worst; at delta 0, 0.4, 0.8; stress-alone per-CK signed errors next to V2 (causal per-k means); demeaned error correlation X vs V2
pass: at most one k block of p with positive mean
mean p <= 0 at delta 0 and at delta 0.8
step2_paired.D_rule: non-inferiority: mean p <= +delta and worst p_i <= +0.10 pp
step2_paired.O1_identified: top weight >= 0.8 in at least half the causal cases; otherwise O1 = 'uncertainty band, not a model' (evaluated, cannot become the main design)

real_scenario: not run in WP2 (WP4 only); real k rows of the screen are predictions, not errors
wp3_note: E2 is not run: F6 shows 4 causal 'phase' cases (< 6), registered exit
